name: app-oviah-typography-specimen-sora-and-inter-heading-scale
title: OVIAH typography guide: Sora and Inter compared side by side with a nine-level heading scale
whatItIs: A white page with two typeface specimens side by side — 'Sora' and 'Inter' — each showing the alphabet, numerals and a table of nine heading levels (Heading 1–9) with weight (Extra Bold/Semi Bold/Medium/Regular) and pixel size for each.
whatItMeans: Comparative and precise; laying two candidate typefaces side by side makes the final choice easy to defend.
techniques: Compare two candidate typefaces in the same layout.
Tabulate every heading level's weight and size.
Show the full character set to judge legibility.

vocabulary.definition: A sample showing a typeface's characters and styles.
The defined sizes for each heading level in a system.
